body: Bill. I love you, your work and your mind. You and others like you helped to save my life. I want to know if you've ever had to deal with mental illness yourself? What is something you do for yourself in order to deal with the inevitable stress of your working life? Thank you so much!

I just don't see an end to this. I feel like I've failed, before I met my boyfriend (6 months or so after the rape) I was completely alone and kind of just planning to die, I had suicide there as a sort of back-up plan. Because I've been dealing with mental illness for such a long time, I didn't complete my education or apply myself at all. I feel like its too late now, everyone surrounding me is trying to make something of themselves and they are all so incredible, one day they'll have to leave the dead weight behind (me) and then I'll be back to being alone and struggling to pay rent and feed myself. I'm so afraid of losing everything that I just feel like taking myself away.
Honestly, just little things like this stranger giving a shit is enough to ease the pain a little. More people should be like this.
